text:
Maya (Design): quick one — added a small 'history lens' that slides up from the timeline. it's a compact summary panel with quick traffic, recent regressions, and snapshot links. putting screenshots in the thread. could use a11y + copy + ordering sanity check before i hand off to eng.
Samir (Eng): looks clean from the mock. q: when the lens opens, does it steal focus? we should trap focus inside and return focus on close.
Maya (Design): yes intended to move focus to the lens header. draft announcement for SR: 'Rollout summary panel open'. current CTA text is `Open lens`.
Ava (Accessibility): prefer label 'Rollout summary' instead of "Summary —" with an em dash. recommendation: move focus to a heading element (e.g. `#lens-heading`) with `role=region` and `aria-label='Rollout summary for vX.Y'`. use `aria-live="polite"` for status updates inside the panel. avoid auto-reading many items at open.
Samir (Eng): implementation note: we can focus `#lens-heading` and apply a focus trap. `aria-live="polite"` is fine — won't interrupt. also suggest adding `aria-describedby` on the heading that points to the short explainer copy.
Elaine (PM): copy suggestions: change CTA from `Open lens` -> `View rollout summary`. add secondary CTA `View full timeline`. microcopy under traffic bar: 'Current allocation across variants'. also we should label the sort order (newest-first/newest-last).
Maya (Design): thanks. one more debate: ordering of snapshots — should the lens list the most recent rollback/patch first (newest-first) or chronologically oldest-first? voiceover reading order differs.
Ava (Accessibility): newest-first is okay if it is clearly labeled. screen reader users expect predictable order; either: keep chronological ascending or explicit announce 'sorted newest first'. if we stick with newest-first, add a visually hidden status text: 'Sorted newest first' and include the live region update when user toggles sort.
Samir (Eng): small perf/telemetry note: the lens loads mini-snapshots from `/api/timeline/summary` — changing default sort will change event names for analytics and tests. we can make the label purely client-side to avoid backend churn.
Elaine (PM): decision: prefer newest-first (users usually want latest at top) but must show label and tooltip 'Why newest first'. Ava please provide the exact SR text for the label.
Ava (Accessibility): SR label suggestion: 'Sorted newest first. To change ordering, open sort menu.' keep it short. for the live update on toggling: 'Timeline order set to oldest first'.
Maya (Design): will update Figma with: CTA text, header focus behavior, SR announcements, and a visible sort badge that reads 'Newest' with tooltip. pushing new link in ~30m. thanks all :sparkles: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: snapshot-service: canary check — 2/3 pods healthy, no regressions flagged.
Samir (Eng): once the figma link is in i'll scope the change — should be a small front-end task + one e2e SR test.
Elaine (PM): adding ticket to backlog and tagging eng for prioritization.
Maya (Design): perfect. follow-up tomorrow for copy polish.
